content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) FUNWAVE-TVD tridiagonal solvers (BSD header L12-L55): three external subroutines used by the dispersive-correction solves. (1) TRIDy_periodic(a,c,d,f) (L70-L291): solves the periodic quasi-tridiagonal system in y using the Sherman-Morrison algorithm, citing 'Thomas, J. W., 1995, Numerical Partial Differential Equations, Springer, Section 5.6.1' (L60-L62; HISTORY 03/07/2014 Jim Kirby, 02/29/2016 Fengyan Shi 'finished and tested' L64-L66). Corner off-diagonal values are stored in a(i,Jbeg) and c(i,Jend) (comment @L93). Steps: if PY>1, per processor-column II exchanges a(i,Jbeg) from the south-end rank ProcessorID(II,1) to the north-end rank ProcessorID(II,PY) and c(i,Jend) the other way via MPI_SEND/MPI_IRECV+MPI_WAITALL (L104-L141); else copies locally (L144-L147). Renormalizes first/last rows: c,d(i,Jbeg)/=(1+c_end(I)) on the south-end rank (L154-L155) and a,d(i,Jend)/=(1+a_beg(I)) on the north-end rank (L160-L161). Saves c1=c @L171 (comment L168-L169 'c and d will get trashed in first call to TRIDy'), pass one CALL TRIDy(a,c1,d,y1) @L175; builds second RHS w: d=ZERO (L181-L185) then d(i,Jbeg)=1.0_SP/(1.0_SP+c_end(I)) @L190 and d(i,Jend)=-1.0_SP/(1.0_SP+a_beg(I)) @L196; pass two CALL TRIDy(a,c,d,y2) @L205. Scale factor: if PY>1 sends y2(i,Jend), y1(i,Jend) from north-end to south-end ranks (L214-L246), south-end computes beta(i)=(c_end*y1(i,Jbeg)-a_beg*y1_end)/(1-(c_end*y2(i,Jbeg)-a_beg*y2_end)) (L251-L252) and broadcasts beta to the other PY-1 ranks in its column (L257-L270); serial variant @L277-L278. Final combination f(i,j)=y1(i,j)+beta(i)*y2(i,j) @L285. (2) TRIDx(a,c,d,f) (L306-L381): distributed Thomas algorithm in x ('parallel version', HISTORY 02/14/2010 Jeff Harris, 05/01/2011 Shi L301-L303). Forward sweep: non-west-edge ranks receive rmsg(Nloc,2)=(d,c) of the west neighbor's last column (L318-L321) and seed the Ibeg column with c(Ibeg,j)=c/a/(1/a - rmsg(j,2)), d(Ibeg,j)=(d/a - rmsg(j,1))/(1/a - rmsg(j,2)) guarded by a.ne.ZERO (L322-L328); interior recurrence c(i,j)=c/a/(1/a - c(i-1,j)), d(i,j)=(d/a - d(i-1,j))/(1/a - c(i-1,j)) (L331-L339); sends (d,c)(Iend,:) east (L341-L349). Back substitution: receive f from east and f(Iend,j)=d-c*rmsg (L353-L359) or f(Iend,j)=d(Iend,j) at the east edge (L361-L363); f(i,j)=d(i,j)-c(i,j)*f(i+1,j) backwards (L366-L370); send f(Ibeg,:) west (L372-L379). (3) TRIDy(a,c,d,f) (L393-L469): identical Thomas pattern in y with n_suth/n_nrth, rmsg/smsg(Mloc,2), seed row Jbeg (L406-L417), recurrence over j (L419-L427), send north (L429-L437), back substitution from Jend (L441-L458), send south (L460-L467). (Header @L385-L386 says 'TRIDx' for the y version — copy-paste.)

verbatim_spans.text: SUBROUTINE TRIDy_periodic ( a, c, d, f)
!      Thomas, J. W., 1995, Numerical Partial Differential Equations, Springer,
!  off diagonal corner values are stored in a(i,Jbeg) and c(i, Jend)
!  Diagonal matrix now stored in a,c.  c and d will get trashed in first call to TRIDy.
SUBROUTINE TRIDx ( a, c, d, f)
!    TRIDx is parallel version of the subroutine to

unresolved: TRIDy_periodic loops L154-L156 and L160-L162 use lowercase loop variable i but index c_end(I)/a_beg(I) with uppercase I — the same identifier in Fortran, so consistent, but beta loops L251/L277 likewise mix beta(i) with c_end(I); the equations rely on i==I identity

TRIDx/TRIDy modify dummy arguments a,c,d in place without INTENT declarations (L312, L399); TRIDy_periodic's comment @L168 documents that c,d are 'trashed' — callers must pass copies (c1=c @L171 protects only the first pass)

TRIDx forward-sweep guard 'if (a(i,j).ne.ZERO)' (L323, L333, L411, L421) leaves c,d unmodified where a==ZERO — the meaning of a zero sub-diagonal row (boundary rows?) is established by the callers, not this file

TRIDy_periodic: the two-rank exchanges (L104-L141, L214-L246) use blocking MPI_SEND before the matching IRECV is guaranteed posted on the peer — correctness relies on eager delivery for Mloc-sized messages when ProcessorID(II,1)==ProcessorID(II,PY) ranks differ; when PY==1 both branches are skipped and a_beg/c_end are copied locally (L144-L147) only over Ibeg:Iend while the parallel path copies 1:Mloc
Sequential dependency: TRIDx/TRIDy pipeline ranks — each rank waits for its west/south neighbor's seed before sweeping (L318-L328, L406-L417), serializing across the processor row/column

Unused declarations: nreq,ll,JJ @L80, myvar,mybeta @L84, Axx,Cxx,Dxx,U1D @L89, rmsg,smsg @L90 (in TRIDy_periodic), commented '! integer i, j' @L402; loop indices i,j,I,J are PARAM module variables (no local declarations despite IMPLICIT NONE)
Header of TRIDy (L385) says 'TRIDx is parallel version...' — copy-paste; file name 'tridiagnal' is itself a misspelling of tridiagonal
